item.description:
OpenClaw 2026.9.6

Highlights

  • Updates: complete managed Gateway upgrades after Node.js installation paths change, and let normal Doctor, finalization, and post-core plugin work finish without implicit deadlines. (#145335, #152973, #153085, #153109, #107930) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @RomneyDa, and @jialele.
  • Restart recovery: recover stranded conversations, preserve active work during Node restarts, and keep sibling completion replay attached to its original requester input. (#153243, #153433, #153435, #153850, #153802) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Usage: restore a complete 30-day history view with creator breakdowns, date selection, and totals that include sessions beyond the visible list. (#152528, #152527)
  • GitHub reader: open public issues, pull requests, commits, comments, and diffs beside chat; installations with an explicit plugin allowlist must add github to retain previews. (#148464)
  • Remote workspaces: use Agent documents, attachments, Memory files, and Skills on paired-node workspaces while preserving file-access and install policy; Gateway and node must run the same OpenClaw version. (#150734, #152635, #154087, #153438) Thanks @Kimiyu-186.
  • Meetings: follow automatically refreshed transcripts and interim summaries while a meeting is still being captured. (#151957)
  • Decision models: choose a separate typed decision model per agent, with hosted and local System One servers supported through the official TypeSafe plugin. (#152237, #152298, #154059) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Models: add Claude Opus 5.5 with adaptive thinking and 1M context, and GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna on the OpenAI API and embedded ChatGPT transports. (#155966, #155967)

Changes

  • Connectors: sign in to MCP connectors directly from Settings. (#151023) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Themes: let agents list, import, and apply personal or plugin themes, with plugin palette changes available through hot reload. (#152460, #152449)
  • Headless nodes: automatically stage and activate packaged runtime updates when owned work and cleanup are idle, while preserving pairing and launch options. (#151545, #151462)
  • Background sessions: start a background session from the command palette without leaving the current conversation. (#152370, #151988) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @jalehman.
  • Cloud sessions and Systems: choose the operating system and machine size when spawning a cloud session, and filter or sort the machine list. (#148034, #153224) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @vincentkoc.
  • Android: choose a device-local text size, inspect message details from their timestamp, zoom and pan chat images, and reorder sidebar pages with accessibility actions. (#152878, #152880, #152877, #152881) Thanks @IWhatsskill.
  • Desktop: provide a consistent Keep computer awake setting. (#152420, #152388)
  • Chat previews: show ordinary external-link hover previews, richer browser cards with favicons, and next/previous navigation between message images. (#152758, #152324, #152027, #152442, #152310, #151981) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Conversation discovery: surface mentioned sessions in Involving me and clarify related conversations in session hovercards. (#152083, #153219, #152072)
  • FaceTime: add an experimental realtime voice bridge plugin. (#119291, #119290) Thanks @omarshahine and @RomneyDa.
  • Local decisions: support ONNX-backed local decision models with provider setup guides. (#153476)
  • Desktop sharing: enable sharing by default with dedicated Mac and Tauri settings controls. (#153359, #153349)
  • Installed agents: select and manage installed agents from Models, including native Copilot CLI model selection. (#150224, #153799) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Keyboard workflows: open and archive sessions with shortcuts, and paste images into command-palette sessions. (#153537, #153238) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @jalehman.
  • Cloud visibility: graph resource history in Systems and identify cloud providers in session pickers. (#153268, #153288, #153264, #153312) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Tool discovery: enable structured Tool Search by default for embedded and Copilot runs when unset; set tools.toolSearch: false to retain direct schemas. Explicit settings and Codex-native discovery are unchanged. (#154068, #154005)
  • TypeSafe installation: move TypeSafe to the separately installed official @openclaw/typesafe plugin, requiring OpenClaw 2026.9.6 or later; retain hosted behavior by default or configure a loopback endpoint for local decisions without forwarding the hosted key. (#154059)
  • Progress cards: request a fresh work-status update without adding a visible chat message, while preserving the draft and previous card until a saved update arrives. (#154044, #154148) Thanks @shakkernerd.
  • Team reports: link activity and member-report entries directly to their work sessions. (#154020, #154004, #154192)
  • Workspace navigation: remember the System busyness panel position and provide a direct Archive action in the session sidebar. (#154207, #154161, #154144)
  • Web search: configure search providers and verify search directly in Settings, honor requested result limits across providers, and drop impossible publication dates from results. (#154135, #154420, #154602, #155365, #155032, #154559) Thanks @ly85206559, @qingminglong, and @obviyus.
  • Local browser: share one local Chrome setup flow across the desktop app and terminal, support Lightpanda connection-scoped CDP replies, open Incognito sessions at their exact URLs, and keep control available once the Gateway activates the plugin. (#152057, #154342, #154644, #154255) Thanks @vincentkoc, @Alix-007, @obviyus, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Plugins: see installation progress and lifecycle feedback, a simpler install flow with grouped settings, Enable listed first for disabled plugins, a microphone icon for Voice, and categories and artwork for FaceTime, GitHub, ONNX, and TypeSafe. (#150235, #150234, #155293, #155249, #155197, #154888) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Themes: let themes drop the mascot, set status words, and add critters and avatar hats, including plugin hats and critter artwork, crown, santa, party, and pumpkin hats, and a composer corner-shape token. (#154518, #154935, #154774, #154583)
  • Models: add xAI Grok 4.7 and Xiaomi MiMo V2.6, show discovered models despite stale provider lists, find chat models by canonical ID, and give local decision models up to 30 seconds. (#155379, #155420, #155180, #154538, #154409) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • Chat composer: mention people from the quick composer, colour and animate the highest effort settings, remember fast mode for the next session, and recover unfinished optional-question drafts with reversible dismissal and visible delivery and retry state. (#154061, #155402, #154690, #154473, #154692, #154486) Thanks @vincentkoc, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @VACInc.
  • Chat previews: show social hover cards for public GitHub links and download inline artifacts over HTTPS. (#155482, #154673)
  • Sessions and access: keep visible work sessions owned by their requester, let guests answer ordinary questions from their own runs, pick explicit local placement for child sessions, add session-scoped operator grants, validate visitor permissions before granting access, and end visitor access when its grant ends. (#155349, #155560, #153912, #154392, #153987, #154461, #153989, #153978) Thanks @shakkernerd, @galiniliev, and @VACInc.
  • Personal context: personalize the USER bootstrap with authenticated profiles and keep it stable when another participant joins. (#153966, #154980) Thanks @VACInc.
  • macOS: ship architecture-specific releases and sign in again from an open dashboard. (#154595, #154639) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Packaging: omit unused native Bash parsers from npm installs and unused Picnic resources from Android packages. (#154843, #154782) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Gateway responsiveness: apply settings without unnecessary restarts, reduce session-list, transcript, catalog, and worker-inventory work on the main thread, speed up transcript artifact downloads and cloud workspace synchronization, and use less memory when shared-state workers start. (#154792, #155705, #155680, #155670, #154804, #154318, #154726, #154770, #153399, #154551, #154705) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Android: keep live and completed tool activity in one compact disclosure with command output, diffs, and failure status, and show chat photos as a compact gallery outside text bubbles. (#155765, #155338) Thanks @IWhatsskill.
  • Web UI: pause background polling on the Channels, Debug, Devices, and Logs pages while the tab is hidden and refresh once when it returns. (#155617) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Gateway responsiveness: keep session lists responsive during live activity updates, read progress cards off the main thread, and skip redundant task-state writes when an attempt reports unchanged activity. (#155767, #155745) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Telegram: rapid bursts of text chunks (such as one long paste) are batched into a single turn with a 300 ms quiet window by default, so long pastes no longer produce partial prompts and multiple replies; set the batching window to 0 to disable. (#155842) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Update: refusals caused by npm selecting a destination owned by another installation now name the destination and running installation with sanitized paths and a documented prefix-mismatch recovery step in reports, openclaw update status, and Doctor. (#155692) Thanks @smaill02.
  • Gateway: Side chat and Talk transcript previews and incremental chat history visibility reads now run off the Gateway request thread, keeping chat responsive on large histories. (#153331, #155870)
  • ACP: the acpx plugin adopts acpx 0.19.1, picking up upstream embedding-log, repeated one-shot startup, adapter admission, and process-cleanup fixes. (#155760) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • OpenAI: add GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna on the API and embedded ChatGPT transports with correct context limits, reasoning levels, and tiered pricing. (#155967)
  • Anthropic: add Claude Opus 5.5 (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, aliases opus-5.5/opus-5-5) with adaptive thinking, 1M context, Claude CLI support, and Opus 5.5 pricing; the bare opus alias still resolves to Opus 5. (#155966)

Fixes

  • Source updates: support shallow partial checkouts and avoid archive-size failures and memory spikes during Git updates. (#154191, #154042) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Update recovery: verify Gateway recovery when finalization fails and avoid false Doctor failures during slow command cleanup. (#153178, #152742, #152788, #152811, #152974, #153000, #153679, #153541) Thanks @neangneatos, @wlassalle724, @0-danielviktorovich-0, @hxy8241, @ZSmallX, and @sebastian-hoebarth.
  • Background work: suppress late failure replies from canceled commands, stale child-wait failures, and question reminders after later work completes. (#153795, #153779, #153849, #153827) Thanks @VACInc and @vincentkoc.
  • MCP connections: keep long-running tool requests connected until their results return. (#153879) Thanks @VACInc.
  • Cloud recovery: resume sessions when workers reconnect after updates and reduce restart delays with multiple cloud sessions. (#154154, #154171)
  • Conversation lists: continue loading when a Matrix, Telegram, or Slack account has been removed. (#153846, #153845) Thanks @masatohoshino and @obviyus.
  • Provider routing: honor selected search providers, avoid borrowing unrelated native-search credentials, and prevent stale client-version rejections during Anthropic OAuth requests. (#154143, #154084, #154098, #94716) Thanks @KrasimirKralev and @SPRIC76.
  • FaceTime calls: retain call ownership and route realtime voice correctly. (#154225)
  • Mobile chat: prevent iOS photo sends from freezing chat and keep attachment rows and long placement choices inside narrow composers. (#154082, #139239, #153080, #153757, #153755) Thanks @Solvely-Colin, @Eragim, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Reader controls: preserve chat controls while replies stream, avoid collaborator-induced scroll jumps, retain text composition during session renaming, and restore focus after file search closes. (#153815, #153061, #129341, #154221) Thanks @vincentkoc and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • macOS lifecycle: wait for Gateway shutdown before reporting success and retain nested worker helpers in packaged apps. (#153789, #154291)
  • Labs settings: apply changes without restarting the Gateway. (#153975)
  • Session repair: recover stale session files with split headers and verified imports whose files are missing or replaced. (#154034, #153655, #152884, #153606, #153619) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui, @cpsleepy, @blackeyes-boy, and @Albertyn87.
  • State availability: preserve plugin writes after database inode reuse and keep restored task writes admitted through worker commit. (#154176, #153852)
  • Skills on Windows: keep workspace watchers working after their root directory is recreated. (#154273)
  • Older-state upgrades: complete schema migrations when updating from 2026.9.2. (#153657) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Package replacement: recover foreground and managed Gateways after manual runtime replacement, reconcile services pinned to another install, and repair official plugin drift. (#153078, #152466, #150898, #153027, #152997, #150744) Thanks @mattkanwisher, @baiwei0427, and @vincentkoc.
  • Doctor recovery: restore Gateways after systemd inspection failures, respect refused config writes, and include plugin load failures in the final outcome. (#153017, #147120, #153640, #152879) Thanks @xilopaint, @vincentkoc, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Proxy updates: verify paired trusted-proxy Gateways with their service credentials. (#153540)
  • Threaded delegation: restore subagent thread spawning under the effective runtime configuration. (#153641) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Matrix delivery: restore queued replies after configuration reloads. (#153645) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Task reliability: keep completed tasks terminal, preserve readable media prompts during concurrent updates, and reduce repeated task-list worker requests. (#153329, #153361, #153612, #153737) Thanks @Gabrielnkl and @obviyus.
  • Cross-session answers: stop delivered replies from bouncing between sessions and prevent fallback notices from replacing A2A answers. (#151297, #152168, #152105) Thanks @RomneyDa, @chelsealong, @obviyus, and @edgarstool.
  • Manual automations: retain acknowledged runs across restarts, execute accepted queued runs, allow manual runs of paused automations, and show completion outcomes in run history. (#153360, #153865, #129396, #129310) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Codex recovery: preserve long tool output after reload, recover oversized preparation frames, and unblock turns left behind by stale process records. (#153542, #153854, #153454, #153295) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Sandbox ownership: apply each runtime owner’s pruning policy so one agent cannot evict another agent’s containers or browser bridges. (#153752) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Memory diaries: restore narrative entries lost when recent diary context was truncated. (#153823, #153682) Thanks @Psychnix and @obviyus.
  • Packaged startup: avoid redundant parsing when preparing plugin SDK aliases. (#153694) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Inbox privacy: isolate dismissals by authenticated account. (#153862) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Migration recovery: let verified session migrations finish despite pending plugins, unlock retained plugin configuration after recovery, and preserve actionable failures instead of false transcript errors. (#153097, #152744, #153079) Thanks @droidyouwerelookingfor, @berklingtools, @wiipud, @ozp, and @ericpearson.
  • Update completion: preserve successful results during concurrent SQLite writes, reconcile interrupted verification, and prevent overlapping lifecycle work during long package updates. (#152986, #152202, #153093) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Update service recovery: repair stale Gateway service definitions, preserve slow but healthy startup, and keep the existing Gateway available while clean builds prepare. (#152120, #151663, #125896, #125305) Thanks @Grynn.
  • Update compatibility: complete post-core work in the candidate runtime, accept the managed activation helper, and tolerate unsupported launcher-symlink metadata. (#144317, #153020, #153081) Thanks @vincentkoc and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Homebrew and installers: preserve stable LaunchAgent paths and show Homebrew-owned update guidance; fall back to portable Node when an installer package manager fails. (#141011, #134386) Thanks @maxsxu and @ly85206559.
  • Update diagnostics: retain the failed finalization step and original cause, identify recovery paths, and avoid reporting rollback before any package mutation. (#148879, #152331, #151667, #152749) Thanks @Navras98 and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Plugin and hook updates: allow ordinary work to finish without default deadlines and avoid archive-update failures caused by development-only dependencies. (#153043, #143350) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev and @giodl73-repo.
  • Doctor: resolve ClawHub plugin repairs from ClawHub, preserve explicitly configured profile workspaces, and report unavailable plugin manifests. (#145103, #145976, #125299) Thanks @DasX, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, @Richard355168, @IWhatsskill, @VACInc, @njuboy11, @xydt-juyaohui, @obviyus, @fszcd, @Alix-007, @altaywtf, and @ericcaiwx-star.
  • Reply delivery: keep required replies after tool completion, continue messages through compaction, and deliver child results despite stale completed tasks. (#152786, #152958, #153157) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Delegated work: retain waiting replies and progress cards while children continue, show active follow-ups, and remove finished children after parent continuations. (#151032, #152517, #153118, #153047) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Task state: retain finished execution outcomes after settlement, stop late activity from reverting completed tasks to running, and show metadata-read failures instead of empty task pages. (#152951, #152367, #152180)
  • Session history: keep projections current during writes, invalidate stale history after rollback or database replacement, and preserve queued work when checkpoint restoration fails. (#142018, #153010, #148877, #127584) Thanks @RomneyDa, @SunnyShu0925, and @obviyus.
  • Cancellation: complete waiting clients after chat cancellation, prevent worker cancellation from hanging shutdown, and keep stale Stop messages from canceling replacement sessions. (#152597, #152994, #152116)
  • Outbound messages: stop retrying obsolete queued replies indefinitely, honor plugin lifecycle during sends, and retain accepted sends if source annotation fails. (#152967, #153105, #151217, #151206) Thanks @hartmark, @obviyus, and @shakkernerd.
  • Attachments: preserve progress attachments during cleanup, deliver files from session worktrees, keep animated WebP images animated, and restore reads through macOS path aliases. (#152645, #151888, #129483, #136218, #152499) Thanks @sahilsatralkar, @Takhoffman, and @yetval.
  • Message formatting: preserve emoji and accented characters across split messages, keep code fences complete in streamed chunks, and retain case-sensitive Signal link destinations. (#151959, #151693, #151754, #127654) Thanks @etzelm, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Alix-007.
  • Telegram: retain settled questions after progress completes, preserve useful discussion between mentions without flooding context, and keep emoji when a sticker is unavailable. (#151329, #151911, #151461, #151328, #150575) Thanks @sercada and @obviyus.
  • Discord and Slack: keep progress cards while subagents continue, preserve text when replying to bot messages, confirm initial thread delivery, and report failed terminal-status updates. (#153028, #151821, #150169, #145778, #150117) Thanks @obviyus, @Alix-007, and @ludovicfourrage.
  • iMessage and Matrix: keep queued answers attached to their questions, return the requested Matrix message instead of unrelated room history, and avoid unnecessary credential reads in Matrix listings. (#150626, #150554, #152124, #150552) Thanks @gennadyclaw, @fuller-stack-dev, and @masatohoshino.
  • Automations: restore current-session announcements in WebChat, keep schedules alive after their creating request ends, retain paused one-shots after Run now, and preserve escaped spaces in commands. (#152960, #152051, #152126, #150071, #150612) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt and @obviyus.
  • Automation validation: reject invalid stagger values before changing a schedule and show failures from repeated persistent-session runs. (#151740, #150315, #146446) Thanks @Alix-007, @obviyus, @aniruddhaadak80, and @jalehman.
  • Talk and Android: retain the selected agent after reconnect, avoid cutting off long spoken replies or repeating GPT-Live answers, and preserve consult answers through late speech finalization. (#152593, #152834, #153087, #150536, #139277, #152822, #153201, #150530) Thanks @saariuslystoned, @obviyus, @destinedenergy, @IWhatsskill, @Marvinthebored, and @shakkernerd.
  • Talk continuity: keep consult answers tied to their live runs and avoid disconnecting the realtime relay when output is canceled. (#153140, #152427, #153129, #150205) Thanks @shakkernerd, @saariuslystoned, @obviyus, and @dimonnld.
  • Android and Wear accessibility: keep large-text headings, attachment controls, and tool errors readable, and make long watch replies fully accessible. (#151341, #151337, #151332, #152041) Thanks @IWhatsskill.
  • Codex background completions: restore memory narratives and isolated text completions on agent-scoped local runtimes with administrator-managed hooks, while retaining managed hooks and native-account/proxy routing and isolating ordinary hooks and model tools. (#151658)
  • Codex startup and delivery: start turns after slow registration reads, avoid Gateway stalls during child startup and exit, preserve delivery facts and native approvals, and explain missing profiles after upgrades. (#153282, #152820, #151863, #153051, #152968) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev and @msobrosa.
  • Claude CLI: restore npm-installed Windows launches and backgrounded Bash follow-up turns, and keep CLI-routed sessions in their selected runtime catalog. (#138504, #149967, #150537, #138424, #144877) Thanks @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, @Vasanthdev2004, @Marvinthebored, @shakkernerd, @Peetiegonzalez, and @Davidofflol12.
  • Provider feedback: surface image-generation refusal explanations, report OAuth catalog failures and upstream HTTP errors accurately, and avoid offering unsupported thinking settings. (#140413, #139079, #141843, #145248, #124158, #114510) Thanks @rondavis007, @obviyus, @StrajnarFilip, @jzakirov, @amittell, and @MasterSwords1.
  • Models and plugins: keep cached plugins alive during refresh, retain healthy apps when optional Codex plugins are missing, and avoid duplicate initialization or mixed registrations. (#151692, #150255, #151927) Thanks @sjf-oa and @sjf.
  • Plugin upgrades: prevent relocated install records from shadowing bundled plugins, reconcile Windows path aliases at safe open, and validate authored SecretRefs when preparing runtime values. (#144843, #151245, #152236) Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
  • Secrets: recover Gateway tokens corrupted by redacted configuration saves. (#151250, #151189) Thanks @wrgrant.
  • Memory and skills: keep lexical recall usable during pending chunking upgrades, preserve forget lineage added during preparation, and stop repeated scans after watched folders disappear. (#144576, #152902, #152903, #144493) Thanks @ruel225 and @Nimoi.
  • Cloud workspaces: start remote turns without requiring a local container, return workspaces after large rebases, and restore editing of managed projects from sandboxed sessions. (#153037, #152566, #152641)
  • Browser and nodes: preserve click/key ordering across relay checks, finish worker cleanup when environments stop, and avoid selecting a non-Node shim for desktop control. (#151650, #152896, #151933, #152906) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666.
  • GitHub previews: display attachments, hide comment metadata, retain compact previews and co-author avatars, resolve named-project links correctly, and show actionable API errors. (#153004, #153193, #151057, #153181, #151047) Thanks @brokemac79 and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Chat history and navigation: load older history with less layout work, recover automatic titles after slow naming, restore the selected task after reload, and expose search in the mobile drawer. (#152979, #153137, #153221, #153185, #150551) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, and @shakkernerd.
  • Composer: preserve question drafts and pending submissions, keep submitted prompts visible during startup, and prevent command-palette prompts from jumping during updates. (#152096, #152241, #153091) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Attachments and panels: open CSV links in the workspace preview, preview HTML attachments larger than 256 KiB, and preserve widget state when moving to an unopened tab. (#152900, #153197, #152738) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Themes and sidebar: preserve custom themes across reloads, apply the selected theme defaults, and keep the sidebar expanded in newly opened session tabs. (#153001, #152254, #153106, #152229) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Usage accuracy: stop presenting unknown pricing as free, export only selected sessions, show saved conversation names, and avoid Windows worker clone failures. (#111175, #152741, #152690, #152962) Thanks @xydigit-zt and @obviyus.
  • macOS: recognize installed Chrome extensions in settings, show About in native connection settings, and hide Inspect Element unless debug is enabled. (#153266, #153184, #153273)
  • Responsive state reads: keep audit persistence, project listings, and heartbeat writes from blocking interactive Gateway requests. (#152745, #152691, #152763) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Meeting history: load complete transcripts and generate missing summaries. (#152463)
  • Updates: finish updates after shared state migrations, keep the canonical handoff database path, preserve run progress and failures through shutdown drains and checkout discovery, stop database locks, live SQLite inspection, and model authentication from aborting updates, restore or alarm on a Gateway left down by failed settlement, and explain refusals when an agent database is in use. (#155610, #155508, #155499, #155498, #153764, #155138, #153839, #154453, #150807, #152976, #154136, #154499, #154200, #152727, #154354, #154219, #154334, #153636, #155394) Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, @SunnyShu0925, @ezimerman, @pfrederiksen, @yetval, @colehammond65, @joshpetras, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Update reports: include npm errors and the failing step's cause, distinguish config validation execution failures, report unavailable service inspection accurately, clarify in-progress updates and snapshot warnings, avoid false version warnings, and record plugin Doctor failures as warnings. (#155337, #155234, #154920, #154892, #154896, #155188, #154697, #154886, #154543) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Source updates: fetch only the authoritative remote for dev-channel updates, exclude extended-stable tags from stable Git updates, and allow transfer packs larger than 256 MiB. (#155133, #154598, #153761) Thanks @RomneyDa and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Doctor: repair stale native Gateway service policy, skip GitHub issue drafts after a clean session SQLite recovery, settle duplicate and JSONL session import archives, recover installed plugin ids after interrupted config writes, preserve escaped references and revision checks through repairs, explain archived registry warnings, and preserve runtime paths during service reinstalls. (#151691, #155246, #155194, #154413, #147714, #147453, #147235, #153314, #155376, #154928, #155265, #153167) Thanks @chelsealong, @vincentkoc, @cortanapham, @fuller-stack-dev, @najef1979-code, @sagebhardt, @fozzels-assistant, @obviyus, and @bipolar84.
  • Chat reading: keep live replies visible during history refreshes, keep replacement session messages and old permission errors with their own transcript, stop panels opening in other split chats after reload, avoid duplicated replies after model fallback, and keep delayed Stop responses and follow-ups with their original chat. (#155404, #154983, #154737, #155528, #155336, #154805, #154806, #154424, #155151) Thanks @vincentkoc and @VACInc.
  • Chat typing: keep Side chat and mentions from blocking typing, stop Cmd+K results jittering, reduce composer typing lag, keep idle chats responsive during background activity, restore supported image pastes, and stop mention searches consuming prompt text. (#155183, #155181, #155104, #154451, #154688, #154367, #154350, #154430, #154000) Thanks @vincentkoc, @vyctorbrzezowski, @hxy91819, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Chat layout: reveal conversation markers after navigation and composer resize, settle saved scroll positions once, prevent Chrome crashes during delayed scrolling and duplicate bullets in Safari, keep chat controls usable in narrow panes, preserve focus outlines and keyboard-navigable multiline text, and close file search with Escape. (#154917, #154730, #154592, #155201, #155232, #155199, #154038, #154454, #153836, #154259, #153478) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Streamed code: preserve identical streamed chunks, leading indentation, and blank lines when formatted replies split, including Telegram code blocks. (#152520, #153587, #154857, #154875, #153576) Thanks @giodl73-repo, @SunnyShu0925, and @obviyus.

  • Cloud: workspace recovery preserves supported filenames containing control characters and exact file bytes, and no longer materializes intermediate copies for rollback snapshots. (#155837)
  • Plugins: retirement results report an independent disposer failure even when it throws the same error as a host cleanup hook. (#154746)

OpenClaw 2026.9.5

Highlights

  • Safer upgrades and retained history: Doctor preserves session history and repeated-repair state, finishes upgrades with invalid retained histories, and avoids repeatedly stalling or stopping a Gateway that is still starting. (#149741, #149956, #148901, #149308, #149823, #149760) Related #149822 Thanks @masatohoshino.
  • Live plugin management: install and reload supported plugins without restarting the Gateway, update tools in active agent and managed Codex conversations, and manage multiple plugins in one CLI command. (#145484, #145710, #145713, #145648, #145917, #149910) Related #149909 Thanks @obviyus.
  • Clearer multi-agent work: distinguish execution from result delivery, use private parent completion handoffs, resume scoped session inventories, and deliver one answer for each steered input. (#147571, #147206, #150065, #148051, #149925) Related #27445, #147955 Thanks @good-warning, @nicknmorty, @obviyus, @VACInc, and @vincentkoc.
  • A desktop-first Systems workspace: manage Gateway connections through web login and switch saved Gateways independently of Primary, with sidebar switching on iOS and Android. (#147519, #148526, #147684, #146641, #148209) Related #147217, #147576, #148205 Thanks @IWhatsskill, @Solvely-Colin, and @vincentkoc.
  • More flexible live voice: use GPT Live across calls and meetings, choose account-specific Talk defaults, and change voices during an active Talk or Discord call. (#145382, #146546, #146676) Related #145071.
  • Citations and review in context: preview cited sources in web and native chats, turn selected chat text into editable comments, reference selected Android review lines, and toggle word wrapping in Review. (#148431, #148904, #148906, #148649, #144101, #143972) Related #144093, #148409 Thanks @ansxor, @IWhatsskill, @Marvinthebored, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @shakkernerd.
  • Simpler model sign-in and selection: align native sign-in with runtime choices, sign in without changing the model, choose across agent harnesses, and connect Radius models with browser sign-in and native streaming. (#143588, #144329, #147994, #145377) Thanks @obviyus.

Changes

  • Conversation navigation: native sidebars preview pending requests, while macOS, iOS, Android, and web chat can collapse completed work so replies and older history remain easier to read. (#149811, #147540, #148002, #148050, #147295) Related #147271, #149682 Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Agent setup and teams: start from role templates and a team preset, show every agent and its sessions in team mode, and use a roster-first Agents home. (#145712, #141476, #141097) Thanks @hannesrudolph.
  • Group conversations: coordinate bounded multi-agent group threads across channels and share selected sessions read-only with a paired team Gateway. (#141411, #136253)
  • Activity and run artifacts: show rolling session recaps, Git changes and PR previews, and select assistant-delivered files by the run that produced them. (#147441, #145530, #147682) Related #145529, #147383 Thanks @onlyysaurabh and @vincentkoc.
  • Browser and dashboards: download assets from the Browser sidebar, share browser dashboards with agents, embed websites in full-screen session dashboards, and save shared split/full-screen defaults. (#144480, #146702, #146312, #146475) Related #144477, #146303, #146308, #146577 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Desktop interaction: control Gateway desktops without a paired node, match virtual worker displays to their viewport, and watch live desktops in Picture-in-Picture. (#147275, #143938, #143836) Related #143829, #147274 Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Remote workspaces: start remote sessions without a repository, select repository-defined source checkouts, and reduce source storage through filesystem snapshots, APFS clones, and ReFS clones. (#147773, #149581, #146251, #146338, #146403) Related #146250, #146288, #149580 Thanks @fuller-stack-dev and @obviyus.
  • Code mode: find MCP tools by task, reuse results between code cells, retain oversized results for later cells, and infer result shape from the requested action. (#147134, #147154, #147278, #147291)
  • Plugin state and background work: offer asynchronous task/flow reads and worker-backed keyed and conditional state operations without removing the supported synchronous SDK paths. (#145851, #146557, #147891)
  • Hot policy changes: apply browser control policy, Telegram access/reply policy, and renewed TLS certificates without restarting their running services. (#146100, #146129, #146267)
  • Model providers: support OpenRouter sign-in from private chat, explicit consent before exposing restricted provider models, and opt-in stored HTTP continuation for compatible Responses endpoints. (#144491, #144468, #128633) Related #123215 Thanks @hartmark, @obviyus, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Codex interaction: answer asynchronous questions while other agent work continues, view usage beside saved logins, and expose slow or failed catalog phases with retained-request correlation. (#144664, #132453, #132454, #148639, #148735, #149616) Related #144643, #148629, #148728 Thanks @jesse-merhi.
  • Daybreak fallback: retry supported cyber-refused turns on Daybreak, surface cyber notices, and announce successful retries. (#143761, #145291, #147146) Thanks @VACInc.
  • Triage handoffs: add Muse, Grok, Cursor, Kimi Code, and Qwen Code handoffs through the existing triage workflow. (#149703, #149877)
  • Automation history: query and paginate run history from the CLI, show readable timer wake timestamps, and list matches when an automation name is ambiguous. (#141777, #141742, #150082) Related #58574, #141745 Thanks @Alix-007, @Celthi, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @shakkernerd.
  • Structured channel questions: answer an agent question directly from its offered Mattermost option or LINE tap. (#135350, #133421) Related #133288, #133418 Thanks @edenfunf and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Chat composition and files: keep drafting while history loads, offer emoji shortcodes, retain file previews in tabs with HTML rendering, and display image attachments inline in the TUI. (#143625, #146737, #146672, #146644) Related #143607, #146590, #146610, #146655 Thanks @VACInc, @vincentkoc, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Review and workboards: inspect CI jobs and steps from PR chips and select or update multiple workboard cards together. (#148070, #144756) Related #147952 Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Personalization: choose an avatar during agent hatching, use custom SVG session icons, and distinguish plugin activity with compact icons. (#146669, #147442, #147333, #143711) Related #143683 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Gateway visibility: show ping and shared activity graphs, a browser-tab status dot, and compact System busyness widgets with all three metrics. (#146755, #147388, #147760, #147840) Related #147343, #147757, #147829 Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Native desktop layout: unify Tauri setup, Quick Chat themes, title bars, and window controls; the macOS app defaults to the web experience while retaining its experimental native experience. (#148808, #147097, #149763) Related #147096.
  • Diagnostics: report when the runtime was built from a different commit than HEAD, expose administrative CPU profiles, and inspect native FreeBSD rc.d service discovery. (#144499, #148004, #148875) Related #148003 Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Provider and channel configuration: expose official channel labels/docs in JSON listings, allow a Discord API URL override, and show comparative cost analysis in the Control UI. (#93265, #118067, #100432) Related #100405 Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Execution options: configure approval-reviewer thinking and fast mode, and default parallel-session capacity to four runs per available CPU. (#147192, #147423) Thanks @VACInc.
  • Plugin SDK migration — Gateway V2: the existing Gateway handler and node-session imports now expose physical WebSocket, generic framed, and HTTP polling capabilities honestly. Before WebSocket-only operations, narrow node.client.webSocket; narrow node.client.socket separately for framed operations. Polling nodes remain visible, and the node wire protocol is unchanged. Migration details: /plugins/sdk-migration/compatibility-policy#gateway-node-transport-sdk-v2. Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Identity and authorization: stop inferring forwarded sender identity from message text, stop MiniMax token requests after chat-login permission is revoked, and preserve attachments whose content types use prototype-like names. (#138579, #149140, #143673) Related #149139 Thanks @LiuwqGit, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @xialonglee.
  • Transcript and session ownership: prevent stale companion/cloud transcript writes, preserve context and ownership across compaction, and track new sessions before their first transcript write. (#149997, #149840, #149712)
  • Final replies and completed work: retain completed tool receipts through text-only finalization and empty-answer retries without repeating completed actions or recording internal continuation prompts as new user messages. Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Large-history responsiveness: keep large session detail and chat metadata reads responsive, avoid blocking the Gateway during memory index publication, and reduce retention work and startup/Doctor memory pressure. (#149749, #149853, #149901, #149754, #149704) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Update and Doctor recovery: preserve shared WAL after a refused restore, unblock shared-state repair for July upgrades, and avoid false pending migrations for bundled runtimes. (#149918, #149753, #149653) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Service upgrades: preserve Gateway authentication when reinstalling legacy services and avoid timing out systemd restart inspection. (#149686, #149970)
  • Managed-service updates: fix service environment refresh failures when upgrading from 2026.9.4 to 2026.9.5 with openclaw update. (#151977)
  • Subagent continuation: inherit the active model at spawn, enforce fork limits against current context, and resume tasks after output-limited tool calls. (#149036, #149666, #149844) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Channel shutdown: finish accepted Telegram work, Discord introductions, and deferred Slack replay before shutdown, while preserving Telegram spool settlement ownership. (#150080, #150072, #150073, #149953) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Channel startup and routing: avoid blocking Discord startup on persisted bindings and allow cross-provider messaging by default. (#149861, #149875)
  • Plugin reloads: reuse the published inbound registry and bundled setup code, keep Lossless usable after settings reload, and validate source reloads under Bun. (#149648, #149646, #149675, #150088) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Provider execution: retain disabled-plugin CLI backend capabilities during inspection, reject incomplete compatible reply streams, and preserve the configured transport during authentication refresh. (#149837, #149842, #150003) Related #149854, #149855 Thanks @obviyus, @zhangguiping-xydt, and @SunnyShu0925.
  • Codex startup and catalogs: prevent service refresh from repeatedly aborting startup, bound catalog memory while retaining tied rows, and avoid repeated scans across multiple homes. (#149365, #150112, #149879) Thanks @bdjben and @obviyus.
  • Automation correctness: prevent extra event-schedule runs, reject ambiguous exact-name lookups, and keep selected automation history and edits attached to the intended task. (#149902, #149958, #149955, #150129) Thanks @Alix-007.
  • Session navigation: retain archive confirmation after leaving Sessions, preserve pagination when switching agents during deletion, and keep newer selections when older mutations finish. (#150108, #150125, #149959)
  • Chat state: keep your own messages right-aligned through refresh and reconnect, and clear resolved queued-message reorder conflicts. (#147634, #149962) Related #147511 Thanks @keith9681, @obviyus, and @SunnyShu0925.
  • Files and selection: keep workspace files readable, preserve Files selection during directory refreshes, retain parent navigation for unavailable folders, and preserve model searches during text composition. (#149499, #149900, #150118, #149845)
  • Windows paths and credentials: preserve state roots during database admission and worker startup, retain credential reads, and read exact configuration filenames containing whitespace. (#149976, #150035, #149124, #149629) Related #149630 Thanks @obviyus and @zhangguiping-xydt.
  • Workspace safety: keep file tools aligned with overlapping sandbox mounts and preserve work through worktree creation and cleanup races. (#148893, #149914) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Legacy updater handoffs: keep the Node runner resolver independent of candidate runtime imports, complete changed-plugin Doctor work through the correct parent/child owner, and inspect copied Doctor contracts in private rehearsals while leaving live installation paths protected. Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Plugin SDK authoring: retain released boolean memory-search enabled values and undefined per-channel responseUsage entries without changing runtime resolution or persisted configuration schemas. Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
  • Shipped SDK compatibility: preserve full-config and readonly roster inputs, versioned legacy model-selection authoring, Discord component registration's void return, and Gateway plugin metadata notifications through their existing lifecycle and restart owners. The deprecated model-policy allowsKey member remains source-only and is never used for authorization; asynchronous completion and errors remain owned after a void call returns. Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.

Complete contribution record

OpenClaw 2026.9.4

Highlights

  • Recover from compatible failed updates: retain the previous package and restore it with the previous configuration and service when schema and configuration checks prove rollback is safe; database migrations still require a verified pre-update backup. (#140339) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Plugins in one place: discover bundled and ClawHub plugins, install them from the Control UI, and manage their setup, settings, and access in a unified Plugins workspace. (#135839, #135840, #139042, #137659, #137886, #138755, #142624, #142782) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Prepared cloud sessions: start eligible Linux sessions from prepared local projects or public GitHub repositories, and build reusable snapshots from the Control UI before starting a conversation. (#143227, #143372, #143410, #143838, #143929)
  • Answer questions in the terminal: use keyboard-driven choices, free-text answers, and multi-question prompts in both Gateway-connected and local TUI sessions. (#143273)
  • GPT Image 2.5: select the new Flare and Sunburst variants for image generation and editing through OpenAI or fal without changing your existing default model. Related #143007. (#143068, #143069) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • More dependable conversation history: recover final replies after interrupted streams, retain timeout notices after reload, and prevent duplicate final answers when live chat hands off to saved history. Related #141839. (#142168, #142135, #142422) Thanks @LiuwqGit, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @von8794, and @jalehman.
  • Voice that finishes delegated work: return subagent results to Talk and deliver the final answer even after repeated rounds of delegation. (#129535, #142830) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Externally managed configuration: set OPENCLAW_CONFIG_READONLY=1 to keep OpenClaw from rewriting deployment-managed configuration while preserving read-only diagnostics and ordinary runtime state. Related #140706. (#140719) Thanks @sallyom.

Changes

  • Rollback and recovery: eligible schema-neutral update failures restore the retained package, command shim, service, and pre-activation configuration, then verify the previous Gateway again. Changed database schemas, incompatible new databases, or intervening operator configuration edits block automatic rollback; a recovered update remains a failed update with a recorded rollback outcome. Use a verified backup before migration-bearing upgrades. (#140339) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Plugin organization: browse installed plugins by category, keep detail tabs together, use short plugin-page URLs such as /reports, and discover installed and ClawHub skills through one search. (#142710, #142711, #142712, #142713, #143183, #143758) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Cloud ready workers: eligible local Git projects and public GitHub repository sessions can reuse prepared workers without repeating setup; private repository-only sessions and paired devices remain outside this preparation flow. The default reserve target is one per project/profile, capped at four Gateway-wide. Ready workers incur provider running-machine charges until deleted. Set cloudWorkers.profiles..readyWorkers or cloudWorkers.preparedPool.maxTotal to zero to disable the corresponding reserves. See warm images and ready workers. (#143227, #143372, #143410)
  • Terminal question controls: navigate choices with arrows or numbers, type an Other answer, toggle multi-select choices, and reopen a pending prompt with /question; local-mode questions last only for the running TUI process. (#143273)
  • Chat navigation and composition: use a compact left-side conversation rail with sender identities in shared-chat previews, add selected text to the main composer, and preview attached videos before sending. Related #142207, #142592, #143473. (#142227, #143486, #142543, #142623) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Skill learning: open learning from past work in a normal session that you can inspect and continue. (#142909) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Command review: let the automatic command reviewer allow, deny, or escalate a command using bounded conversation context while retaining the execution policy's authority. (#141987, #142279)
  • Node runtime recovery: offer a Node.js update when the CLI runtime is incompatible and keep diagnostics and update commands available to help repair the installation. (#142742, #143344) Thanks @jason-allen-oneal and @morrow-bluedot.
  • Read-only deployments: honor host-owned OPENCLAW_CONFIG_READONLY=1 across configuration writes, setup, Doctor repairs, plugin changes, and updates; read-only configuration commands continue to work, and this mode does not make runtime state read-only. Related #140706. (#140719) Thanks @sallyom.
  • Upcoming SDK deprecation: agent-harness-credential-prompt-string-argument entered deprecation on September 9, 2026; the legacy string argument to buildCredentialSafetyPrompt remains supported through November 30, 2026; plugin authors should pass { controlToolsAvailable }. See credential prompt migration. Related #128076. (#143238) Thanks @ejc3.
  • SDK context compatibility: sdk-untrusted-context-identifier-aliases reached its September 8, 2026 removal date but remains removal-pending; retain the deprecated untrusted-named context aliases while published plugin readers migrate to the channel-named replacements; removal remains pending migration verification and explicit breaking-release acceptance. See plugin compatibility. (#142708)
  • Cloud snapshot controls: build, rebuild, inspect, pin, delete, and roll back supported cloud-worker snapshots from Settings → Connections → Cloud workers → Snapshots. Active builds can be canceled with confirmation; held or pinned images remain protected. Snapshot storage and ready-worker charges still apply. (#143814, #143838, #143893, #143929)
  • Cloud placement and diagnostics: edit advanced worker profiles and repository defaults, inspect cloud-session machine specifications, and select native Windows workers when the backend supports them. Warm images and desktops remain Linux-only. (#143801, #143864, #143769, #143798)
  • Deepgram voice notes: transcribe voice notes with flux-general-en or flux-general-multi through Deepgram Flux; these models require ffmpeg. See Flux configuration. Related #129452. (#141836) Thanks @obviyus and @safzanpirani.
  • Slow session diagnostics: identify the work holding a session lifecycle queue and see which artifact-cleanup preparation stage is taking time. Related #143885, #143939. (#143886, #143942)

Fixes

  • Access and content boundaries: preserve existing WhatsApp group allowlists during security repairs, continue blocking cloud-metadata addresses when private IPv6 exceptions are enabled, bound Slack HTTP request bodies, and restrict Tlon citation retrieval to the cited post. Reject stale signed Feishu webhook callbacks, prevent attachment reads from sibling agent sandboxes, and stop pipelined MCP calls after a rejected upload. Related #107972. (#142589, #137684, #136508, #142041, #143484, #143521, #143724) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @drobison00, @pgondhi987, and @yetval.
  • Workspace and backup safety: preserve concurrent workspace edits, include required external configuration files in full backups, keep private update captures out of ordinary exports even after they move, and tolerate a disappearing live SQLite sidecar after its database is snapshotted. Related #141042, #143678. (#135865, #141161, #143693, #143799, #143899) Thanks @yetval, @obviyus, @LiuwqGit, @Cobblestone-Digital1, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Migration recovery: recover markerless multi-agent configurations, leave ambiguous Skill Workshop migrations available for review, explain hard-linked session migration refusals, and preserve normalized media when republishing migrated archives. Retain legacy Codex assistant messages during session SQLite import and repair the dangling Workshop review index. Related #142582, #142585, #143094, #142584, #143593, #140100. (#143202, #143141, #143195, #143595, #140296, #142522) Thanks @GitHoubi, @fahrenhe1t, @fuller-stack-dev, @ylcn91, @ikenraf, @jjjhenriksen, @RomneyDa, and @pash-openai.
  • Doctor and authentication: preserve source state during full lint, keep saved authentication profiles aligned during migration, scope legacy auth-profile refusals to affected providers, recover legacy node tokens with invalid scopes, and prevent stale shared OAuth refresh generations from overwriting newer credentials.
